title: Nauru Climate Impact, Vulnerability and Risk Assessment: Synthesis Report
organization: Commonwealth Scientific and Industrial Research Organisation (CSIRO), prepared for SPREP and the Government of Nauru
temporal_coverage: 2025 synthesis of four climate hazard, vulnerability, exposure and risk assessments, with recent conditions and projections to 2050 and beyond.
methodology: CSIRO synthesis compiles four technical climate hazard, vulnerability, exposure and risk assessments prepared for Nauru’s adaptation-planning project.
limitations: The synthesis reports data and confidence limits; district-level social vulnerability is less detailed than physical exposure.

title: Republic of Nauru Framework for Climate Change Adaptation and Disaster Risk Reduction II (RONAdapt II)
organization: Government of the Republic of Nauru, Department of Climate Change and National Resilience
temporal_coverage: Government framework dated 2025, based on the 2024 review and consultation process; includes current assessments and planned adaptation actions.
methodology: Government framework combines sector risk studies and 2024 consultations.
limitations: Activities are plans, not evaluated outcomes.

title: Republic of Nauru Updated Nationally Determined Contribution
organization: Government of the Republic of Nauru
temporal_coverage: Updated contribution covers 1 January 2021 through 31 December 2030 and sets out conditional and unconditional intended actions.
methodology: National climate contribution organized around sustainable-development priorities and cross-sector policy actions.
limitations: Commitments and targets do not establish that projects were completed or outcomes achieved.

title: PACC Nauru: Adapting water resource management to increase climate-resiliency and protect against future climate change risks
organization: United Nations Development Programme (UNDP), with Government of Nauru, SPREP, GEF and Australian Government
temporal_coverage: Project page reports completed status but gives no publication or implementation dates in the opened text.
methodology: Official UNDP project summary page describing project aims, context and listed results and outputs.
limitations: Page is not a project evaluation and provides no measured water-security impact estimates.
